description.en: Both split reach into conveying distance and delivery height, and both print pipe 100 / 125 mm. Power source and the metre values differ.
description.zh: 两边都把距离拆成输送距离和输送高度，管径都印 100 / 125 mm。动力和米数不同。

directAnswer.en: HBT8018 and LZ-60 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai that both print pipe 100 / 125 mm and aggregate 4 cm and below. HBT8018 prints a 132 kW motor, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, conveying distance 150 m and height 450 m. LZ-60 prints engine 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying distance 100 m and height 300 m. Same label style does not mean the same metres.
directAnswer.zh: HBT8018 和 LZ-60 是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，管径都印 100 / 125 mm，骨料都是 4 cm 及以下。HBT8018 印 132 kW 电机、60 m³/h、40 MPa、输送距离 150 m、高度 450 m。LZ-60 印发动机 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、高度 300 m。标题样式相同，不等于米数相同。

heading.en: Where HBT8018 and LZ-60 print different values

body.en: Model line: HBT8018 prints HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S; LZ-60 prints LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132. Theoretical output: HBT8018 prints 60 m³/h; LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h. Pumping pressure: HBT8018 prints 40 MPa; LZ-60 prints 35 MPa. Conveying distance: HBT8018 prints 150 m; LZ-60 prints 100 m. Delivery height: HBT8018 prints 450 m; LZ-60 prints 300 m. Dimensions: HBT8018 prints 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm; LZ-60 prints 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. The same printed value on a shared label: Max. aggregate size is 4 cm and below on both pages; Delivery pipe diameter is 100 / 125 mm on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 型号行：HBT8018印 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S；LZ-60印 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132。理论输送量：HBT8018印 60 m³/h；LZ-60印 50 m³/h。泵送压力：HBT8018印 40 MPa；LZ-60印 35 MPa。输送距离：HBT8018印 150 m；LZ-60印 100 m。输送高度：HBT8018印 450 m；LZ-60印 300 m。外形尺寸：HBT8018印 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm；LZ-60印 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。同一标题下数值相同的有：最大骨料粒径两边都是 4 cm and below；输送管内径两边都是 100 / 125 mm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: HBT8018 prints cells that LZ-60 does not: Motor power 132 kW. LZ-60 prints cells that HBT8018 does not: Engine power 6105 / 145 kW. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: HBT8018有、LZ-60没有的行：电机功率 132 kW。LZ-60有、HBT8018没有的行：发动机功率 6105 / 145 kW。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Use the split labels, then keep each metre value on the page that prints it. Open /en/products/hbt8018-concrete-pump/ for HBT8018 and /en/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/ for LZ-60. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 先认出拆开的标题，再把每个米数留在印出它的那一页。看HBT8018请打开 /zh/products/hbt8018-concrete-pump/，看LZ-60请打开 /zh/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does HBT8018 print the same model line as LZ-60?

answer.en: No. HBT8018 prints HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S. LZ-60 prints LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT8018印 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S。LZ-60印 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does HBT8018 print the same theoretical output as LZ-60?
question.zh: HBT8018和LZ-60的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. HBT8018 prints 60 m³/h. LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT8018印 60 m³/h。LZ-60印 50 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does HBT8018 print the same pumping pressure as LZ-60?

answer.en: No. HBT8018 prints 40 MPa. LZ-60 prints 35 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT8018印 40 MPa。LZ-60印 35 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is motor power missing on LZ-60?

answer.en: The LZ-60 page does not print that label. HBT8018 prints 132 kW. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: LZ-60这一页没有印这个标题。HBT8018印的是 132 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
